meta.file: Sahayakai mobile app design.zip (SahayakAI Design System, 2026-10-08) + SahayakAI Mobile v3 (standalone).html
frames: v3 canvas: 16 screens, 01 Onboarding to 16 Offline and you

color.note: One theme, as the source draws it. The app's only dark surface is the scanner (screen 11), held in the camera-* tokens. Prod web and Flutter still ship their own dark modes; a SahayakAI dark theme is an open decision.

tokens.name: milk-50
tokens.usage: Card and sheet surface; the solid ground under sheets, the deliver tray and website cards. Base of `surface-card`.

tokens.name: milk-100
tokens.usage: Warm white. Text on `ink-800` (16.9:1) and on the CTA band gradient; the website's primary-on-dark label.

tokens.name: milk-200
tokens.usage: Website page ground. Base of `surface-web`.

tokens.name: milk-300
tokens.usage: Inset ground for the Composer, context cards ("This page", "Draft so far") and deliver options. Base of `surface-inset`.

tokens.name: milk-400
tokens.usage: Website band ground, alternated with `milk-200` down a page. Base of `surface-band`.

tokens.name: milk-500
tokens.usage: App canvas ground behind phone screens and the design canvas. Base of `surface-page`.

tokens.name: ink-900
tokens.usage: Primary text: titles, values, row labels. 15.2:1 or better on every app ground, including tints. Also the camera ground (screen 11).

tokens.name: ink-800
tokens.usage: Dark fill: the website nav CTA pill and the one dark FeatureCard; `milk-100` text on it.

tokens.name: ink-600
tokens.usage: Body and secondary text, chip labels, sublines. 6.2:1 or better on every app ground.

tokens.name: ink-500
tokens.usage: Muted text and inactive tab icons: placeholders, the orb hint label, timestamps. 4.7:1 or better on every app ground.

tokens.name: ink-400
tokens.usage: Faint text: website eyebrows, footer links, metric CTAs. 3.2-3.9:1, so only at 13px+ beside a stronger label, never for body copy. Flagged (source value).

tokens.name: stone-500
tokens.usage: Pending and offline grey: the not-yet step in the working checklist (screen 06) and the offline orb (screen 16). 3.1-3.8:1: always paired with a word.

tokens.name: stone-100
tokens.usage: Highlight of the offline orb (screen 16).

tokens.name: saffron-100
tokens.usage: Orb highlight while dragging; the warm stop in orb gradients.

tokens.name: saffron-200
tokens.usage: Orb highlight at rest and while listening; the saffron glow on screens.

tokens.name: saffron-300
tokens.usage: Testimonial voice bars and the testimonial avatar highlight (website).

tokens.name: saffron-400
tokens.usage: Decorative warm mid-tone for website glows. Not for text.

tokens.name: saffron-500
tokens.usage: THE brand accent: the orb, the mic disc, the active tab disc, status dots, progress bars and focus edges. Never under white text (3.77:1): a saffron fill that carries a label uses accent-fill (saffron-600, 5.28:1), decided 26 Oct 2026. As text it is 3.1-3.7:1: large text and icons only.

tokens.name: saffron-600
tokens.usage: Saffron as text: eyebrows, text actions ("Open", "Change"), links, the active tab icon on a tint, the focus ring. 4.7:1 or better on every app ground except leaf tints (4.4).

tokens.name: saffron-700
tokens.usage: Deep saffron text on saffron and amber tints: language pills, warning row labels, the offline notice title. 5.6:1 or better on every app ground.

tokens.name: saffron-750
tokens.usage: Body text of the offline notice (screen 16): 5.9:1 or better on its saffron tint.

tokens.name: saffron-800
tokens.usage: Deepest saffron: the CTA band's dark stop and its button label on `milk-100` (7.6:1).

tokens.name: leaf-100
tokens.usage: Highlight of the ready orb.

tokens.name: leaf-300
tokens.usage: The live dot in the website hero eyebrow. Decorative only.

tokens.name: leaf-500
tokens.usage: Selected class and Include chips, done ticks, the ready orb, present marks, the Submit attendance button, the "On call" pill. White on it is 7.55:1.

tokens.name: leaf-700
tokens.usage: Leaf as text on leaf tints: "Mic on", pills, completed checklist steps. 8.2:1 or better.

tokens.name: indigo-100
tokens.usage: Highlight of the working orb.

tokens.name: indigo-500
tokens.usage: VIDYA working (orb, progress bar, the active checklist step) and curriculum (board marks, curriculum pills, the curriculum notice). 8.1:1 or better as text; white on it 9.9:1.

tokens.name: red-500
tokens.usage: Absent, wrong and urgent: status dots, the absent mark, "22 wrong", End call. White on it 5.44:1; as text 4.5:1 or better on cards and glass. Always with a word.

tokens.name: red-700
tokens.usage: Red as text on the absent row tint. 7.6:1 or better.

tokens.name: amber-500
tokens.usage: Late, queued and waiting: status dots, the late mark, the level-2 rubric badge. White on it 5.02:1. As text use `saffron-700`.
